**Date:** The rating was confirmed on 14 March 2031, when the plant completed its final commissioning test.

**Person:** Dr. Ingrid Halvorsen-Pell, chief engineer of the Tessaly Fjord Energy Authority, signed off on the rating.

**Figure:** The plant's 12 turbines each contribute roughly 7.9 megawatts, for a combined rated capacity of 95 megawatts.

**Source document:** The Tessaly Fjord Commissioning Report (Ref. TFEA-CR-2031/07), published by the Authority at the close of the test.
